posts.author: jean
posts.content_md:
I've tried one time mixture of PVA, TEA, Methylenebis Acrilamyde, Acrylamide, MB. It was a self-developping mixture but Acrylamide is very dangerous for your future !!!!! 

Low resolution (about 2000 l/mm in 633 nm) but it works (only for transmission)

But yes, papers about this stuff always point the low sensitivity (lower than DCG).

Send me an email if you wish them (about DC-PVA). With DC-PVA, you can make reflection hologram. It's a slf-developing stuff but you need a post-exposure processing to increase DE (I don't remember wich processing, wet or heating ?)

Jean
